# Duffy Realty of Las Vegas — Beazer Homes Buyer Agent

> Dr. Jan Duffy is the Award Winning Buyer Agent for Beazer Homes in Las Vegas, Nevada. Nevada-licensed real estate agent (S.0197614.LLC), PhD, Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties. Specializes in new construction representation across Las Vegas, Henderson, Boulder City, and Mesquite — floor plans, community comparison, builder incentive negotiation, construction timeline management.
